mentions.name: Rust port of SeL4
mentions.description: This project is a hand port of the SeL4 operating system kernel from C to Rust, carried out over about a week to learn how SeL4 works and to study OS development more generally. It is also a Rust kernel project that can be built with a simple `cargo build`.
mentions.problem: SeL4's use of cmake to compile the kernel and userland software is insanely complex and a major pain point to understand; a Cargo-style build just works instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've spent the last week or so hand porting SeL4 from C to Rust, mostly so I can learn how it works (and learn OS development more generally).

evidence.value: I've spent the last week or so hand porting SeL4 from C to Rust, mostly so I can learn how it works (and learn OS development more generally).
